# Vixiem

> Vixiem is an automated real-time API health intelligence and endpoint observability platform.

Vixiem provides continuous latency tracking, instant downtime alerts, AI-driven root cause diagnostics, and developer-first SDK integrations for modern web applications.

## Platform Links

- [Overview](https://vixiem.vercel.app/): Main landing page with live telemetry metrics, endpoint tracking features, and pricing tiers.
- [Register](https://vixiem.vercel.app/register): Create a free account to begin monitoring your API endpoints.
- [Login](https://vixiem.vercel.app/login): Access the developer dashboard, API keys, and incident management logs.
- [System Status](https://vixiem.vercel.app/status): Real-time platform status, response latency, and global region availability.

## Developer Features

- Real-Time Endpoint Health Monitoring (HTTP status codes, latency percentiles, error rate tracking)
- Automated AI Error Diagnostics and intelligent triage recommendations
- Multi-region synthetic health probes across global datacenters
- SDK Support for Node.js, Python, Java, and Go in under two minutes
